name: Rizuhble's Aura Farming Victor
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Grit
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Losing trades up close. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-5,600 (levels 1-11). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Shocking Reanimation unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Torment Pulse. Ultimate (Shocking Reanimation) is available from Torment Pulse.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 16 to Pain Battery's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 28.8 to Pain Battery's damage (1.60x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 11 to 38 spirit power.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 5,600-18,400 (levels 11-24). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Pain Battery T3, Aura of Suffering T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pain Battery, damage) grows from 207 to 373. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Enduring Speed.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Enduring Speed, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Enduring Speed completes 800 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Enduring Speed completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 8k tier completes at Compress Cooldown, 6400 souls (~6.4 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Jumpstart: takes 18% off its 22s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,800 to 13,600 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Shocking Reanimation radius (18m), Aura of Suffering radius (9m). Takes spirit from 13,600 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 266s; 20% off is 53.2s per full rotation.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 30,400-59,200 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Jumpstart T3, Shocking Reanimation T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pain Battery, damage) grows from 418 to 627.

items.name: Scourge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 66 to Pain Battery's damage (2.20x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 24,000 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: If you bought Healbane, sell it for this.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Infuser? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.
sections.desc: Dying after Infuser? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: A gun carry outshoots you while you sit in the aura.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows that pull you out of aura range.

items.name: Healbane
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns and slows keep you off them.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 171s of base cooldown across your kit, 145s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Torment Pulse: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: Resets your revive too, so you can come back twice in one fight. Sell Torment Pulse for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Healing Booster for 4,800 more souls: bonus fire rate 0 to 35; tech resist 0 to 10..
